description: A fixed translation overlay for plan B (Step 2 item 5). Lingala answers laid over tests/fixtures/answers/both.json, with the language each was given in and the English an NLLB run might give. The English is written by hand, not by a model, so the goldens never move with one. It covers: machine translations on top-level and loop fields; a translation a person edited (no [MT] mark); a stale translation whose source changed (not used); a Lingala answer with no translation yet (kept as given); and an answer given in English (never translated).
